title: Use a line for ordered change
summary: A line chart can show how a value changes across an ordered sequence, such as days.
introduction: A line chart can show how a value changes across an ordered sequence, such as days. Your task: Add Thursday with 25 minutes.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for use a line for ordered change

blocks.text: A line chart can show how a value changes across an ordered sequence, such as days.
Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Use a line for ordered change

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`maintainAspectRatio: false` lets the Chart.js canvas use the explicit height of its parent holder.

blocks.text: Straight line segments connect the reading minutes in day order.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not join unrelated unordered categories with a line if that implies a change that does not exist.
